title: Clinical Pharmacology
summary: Bounded, repeatable workflows a clinical pharmacologist owns or reviews across the document spine — protocols, study reports, evidence packages, submission summaries and labelling content. Every skill reviews, reconciles, structures or flags; qualified humans decide, approve, sign off and submit.

skills.title: Demographic Covariate Effects Assessment
skills.workflow: Assess whether age, sex and body-size covariate effects are characterised, internally consistent, and traceable to their sources across PopPK, sub-studies and labelling.

skills.title: Development Plan Gap Assessment
skills.workflow: Assess a clinical pharmacology development plan for evidence and study gaps.
skills.gate: The merge of plan-gap and evidence-gap assessment into one skill is an unvalidated assumption. Practitioner validation may split it back apart.

skills.title: Pharmacogenomic Evidence Assessment
skills.workflow: Assess whether pharmacogenomic covariate effects are characterised across the programme's evidence base — in-vitro metabolism, PopPK covariate analyses, dedicated PGx sub-studies and labelling.

skills.title: Protocol Amendment Impact Assessment
skills.hold_reason: Risk veto recorded in the research scoring. Real-time, blinding-constrained and safety-critical committee work.
skills.workflow: Classify amendment changes against enrolment, assess poolability per analysis, name objectives preserved, degraded or lost, and build the propagation list from dependent documents.

skills.title: Special Population Strategy Assessment
skills.workflow: Assess the completeness and internal consistency of a programme's special-population evidence strategy against declared scope, TPP and guidance-anchored criteria.

skills.title: Applicant's Position Authoring
skills.workflow: Draft and review clinical pharmacology applicant's-position sections of a regulatory briefing package with evidence tracing, position-drift detection and commitment-language extraction.

skills.title: Meeting Minutes and Commitment Capture
skills.workflow: Capture structured minutes and commitment records from a regulatory interaction with verbatim commitment extraction, position reconciliation and open-item tracking.

skills.title: Check Investigator's Brochure PK Section

skills.title: Curate Sops Templates Knowledge Assets

skills.title: Safety Committee Decision Documentation
skills.hold_reason: Risk veto recorded in the research scoring. Real-time, blinding-constrained and safety-critical committee work.
skills.workflow: Record a committee decision as one action with quorum verified against the charter, trace every element of the stated basis to the pack, and preserve dissent, conditions and non-decisions with owners.

skills.title: Extract Embedded IND IMPD Clinical Pharmacology Content
skills.workflow: Locate and inventory clinical-pharmacology mechanism and ADME content embedded in IND or IMPD structures without deciding phase adequacy, filing readiness, or acceptance.

skills.title: Agency Question Evidence Map
skills.workflow: Map an authority question to evidence, gaps, owners and a reviewed response draft.
skills.gate: States no numeric turnaround norm — the commonly cited figure is practice-only and was not evidenced.

skills.gate: Reviewer-side only. The performer-versus-reviewer split varies by company and is a configurable input, never an assumed organisational model.

decides whether an analyte is scientifically necessary
harmonises, reconciles or chooses between conflicting analyte definitions
judges whether a reported ratio or DAR shift is biologically reasonable
reviews or opines on bioanalytical method validation
approves, signs off, or submits anything
